text:
devin: deploy-bot suggested an automated rollback for rollout/2026-04-02T18:00Z due to sustained p95 latency increase on canary (model-alpha). Autopilot reason: p95_delta>180ms. https://grafana/redwood/rollouts/alpha :warning:

deploy-bot: autopilot:recommend_rollback for rollout/2026-04-02T18:00Z reason: p95_latency>threshold over 8m. Action: approve rollback or run manual mitigation.

rita: pinging @sasha @cust-rel. Is impact broad or localized? We need to decide whether to allow autopilot or do a targeted pin.

sasha: quick triage: traces show a spike in KV-cache misses on two canary shards; not universal. I also see one host with degraded network IO.

devin: given it's shard-specific, prefer manual targeted pin of the affected shards to previous stable variant instead of full rollback. Less customer disruption.

cust-rel: if we do a targeted pin, please prepare a short customer line: "We're routing a portion of traffic to a stable model to restore latency; some customers may see minor delay changes." Keep it minimal.

rita: plan: suppress autopilot rollback for 15m, pin shard-3+shard-5 to model-alpha-stable for 1h, route 25% traffic away from problematic hosts, and collect heap + kv stats. If pin doesn't reduce p95 within 7m, we escalate to full rollback.

deploy-bot: note: autopilot action suppressed by human request. Manual override token required for autopilot to proceed.

sasha: commands ready: `releases/pin --shard shard-3 --model model-alpha-stable --duration 1h && releases/pin --shard shard-5 --model model-alpha-stable --duration 1h` and `routing/adjust --service inference --shards shard-3,shard-5 --pct 25% --to model-alpha-stable`

devin: executing pins and routing in 30s. Will post status.

(deploy updates)

release-bot: change: shard-3 pinned -> model-alpha-stable (1h), shard-5 pinned -> model-alpha-stable (1h). Routing adjusted: shard-3,shard-5 25% -> model-alpha-stable.

sasha: after routing, p95 on affected shards dropped from +220ms to +35ms. KV-miss rate normalized. Heap snapshots uploaded: https://drive/ops/alpha-kv-4723456789

cust-rel: sending one-line customer note now.

devin: hold maintained until 30m stable and postmortem created. If stable, we'll plan a scoped re-release after fixing the KV eviction path. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
